name: Spotless POS
desc_id: Antarmuka kasir point-of-sale berfitur lengkap untuk operasional cuci mobil premium. Tata letak split-screen dengan grid produk 3 kolom (Self Service, Rollover, Automatic, Detailing, Add-on) dan panel tagihan real-time.
desc_en: A full-featured point-of-sale interface for premium car wash operations. Split-screen layout with a 3-column product grid (Self Service, Rollover, Automatic, Detailing, Add-on) and a real-time billing panel.
